name: tier1_projection_W
_what: OBJECT-PROJECTION RULING INSTRUMENT — one scene per candidate. NOT A PROPS PASS.

W — TWO PLANES, the §3 reading. Top surface plus the south-facing front face, no side. This is the walls' own grammar applied to objects, and it is the only candidate the ratified clause permits as written: '§3: Objects and walls present exactly two visible planes: a front face and a top surface.'

Five archetypes, chosen to stress every case the game contains, in the ratified room on real floor and walls at the ratified rig. The placements are IDENTICAL across the three candidates so the only variable is the projection.
tall vertical   a standing stone      does its side read against the wall's, or fight it
low horizontal  a chest               the classic oblique case; top-to-face ratio lives here
round           a barrel              round objects expose projection cheats; no flat face to hide behind
wide flat       an altar slab         mostly-top; tests whether the top truly shares the floor plane
against a wall  a rack                Rafe's 'bookcase' instinct, asked directly

⚠ IDS 9850-9870 ARE A RESERVED REVIEW BLOCK. They are referenced by these three scenes and nothing else: no props manifest lists them, no placer places them, no game scene names them. Nothing in this session enters the game's prop set — it is a ruling instrument, and the ruling is Rafe's, on device (§13.1/§13.2).
